facts.summary: Interim data showed weak lung function and mixed mucus reduction · Phase 2 · ARCT-032 in cystic fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Initial analysis comparing FEV₁ values from Day 1 to Day 28 did not demonstrate meaningful improvement.
evidence.safety: The treatment was generally safe and well tolerated.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company intends to initiate a 12-week safety and preliminary efficacy study in up to 20 CF participants in the first half of 2026.
